original_ai_output.title_zh: 环保人士在开普敦非洲能源周会场外抗议
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非开普敦非洲能源周会议场外，气候活动人士举行抗议，呼吁停止非洲大陆新的石油和天然气勘探。绿色和平非洲与灭绝叛乱组织活动人士指责能源公司把利润置于民众和环境之上。抗议者认为进一步投资化石燃料将加剧气候变化并威胁社区。

location.raw_text: outside the African Energy Week conference, in the South African city of Cape Town

key_facts.fact: 气候活动人士在南非开普敦非洲能源周会议场外举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Climate activists picketed outside the African Energy Week conference in Cape Town, South Africa, on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 抗议者呼吁停止非洲大陆新的石油和天然气勘探
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: calling for an end to new oil and gas exploration across the continent

key_facts.fact: 抗议者指责能源公司把利润置于民众和环境之上
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: accusing energy companies of prioritising profits over people and the environment

key_facts.fact: 绿色和平非洲与灭绝叛乱组织活动人士参与抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Greenpeace Africa and Extinction Rebellion campaigners challenged efforts to position Africa as a new frontier for fossil fuel development

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
